bio: The master of her own fate. Writer of her own destiny. Kris's magic allows her to turn imagination into reality, even allowing her to write her enemies' endings into being. The book that she floats above contains its own pocket world, birthed from Kris's own quill, one where she can summon flocks of magical birds to do her bidding.
